evidence: The any-repo claim holds: stamphog_connected is get_stamphog_connected (products/review_hog/backend/api/settings.py:50-54, 72-80) -> has_reviewable_repo_config (products/stamphog/backend/facade/api.py:112-127), which filters only enabled/connected_by_user_id/installation_id with no repository filter, while the worker leg process_inbox_pr_review (products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:1137-1152) resolves the config by repository__iexact and on a miss does logger.info('stamphog_inbox_pr_repo_not_reviewable') and returns before any ReviewRun row or GitHub comment exists, so an Inbox PR in a second, unconnected repo leaves no trace in either the Stamphog run list or the Code review page (the docstring at tasks.py:1121-1123 calls this a deliberate silent no-op; the ReviewHog leg by contrast fails loudly with a non-retryable ApplicationError at products/review_hog/backend/temporal/activities.py:442-450). The copy gap is also real: the switch text at products/review_hog/frontend/CodeReviewScene.tsx:1053-1057 says 'Stamphog reviews it and approves it if it passes' with no connected-repository qualifier, unlike the label switch at 1090-1091 ('in a connected repository'); the disabled tooltip at 1066-1067 is a plain string, products/review_hog/frontend has no urls.stamphog() reference (grep), products/stamphog/manifest.tsx:34 has treeItemsProducts: [] so Stamphog has no Browse entry, and there is no stamphog reference in frontend/src/lib/components/CommandBar or frontend/src/scenes/settings, so the only route to setup is typing /stamphog. Severity stays at consider because nothing incorrect is produced (no wrong approval, no cost, no data loss), the skip is logged, the scene is staff-only during the alpha (CodeReviewScene.tsx:1548-1557) so the audience knows the URL, the serializer help_text at settings.py:27-32 already documents the project-level precondition, and the third suggestion (keep the switch usable for opt-out while disconnected) is already implemented at CodeReviewScene.tsx:1064-1066.
notes: Upgrade to should_fix if the staff gate is dropped or multi-repo Inbox projects reach non-staff users while the unconnected-repo skip still surfaces nothing in-app; downgrade to not real if the toggle copy names connected repositories and the scene (or Stamphog's manifest) gains a link or nav entry to /stamphog.
